recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, nearly monochromatic close-up portrait of a subject with wet-look hair, characterized by blown-out highlights that blend the skin into a pure white background. The composition is anchored by sharp, dark details in the eyes and lips, framed by wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif typography at the top and bottom margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between dark facial features and overexposed skin tones
Symmetrical balance between the centered face and the horizontal text bands
Visual tension between the soft, blown-out edges of the subject and the sharp, geometric letterforms
Minimalist color palette focusing on grayscale with a single tiny saturated accent
coreInvariants: High-key lighting style where midtones are pushed toward white
Extreme wide tracking (letter-spacing) in all text elements
Pure white negative space surrounding the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central close-up; the face occupies the middle third of the vertical axis, with hands framing the chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, rendered with high contrast and sharp detail, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top display text, drops to the eyes, follows the vertical line of the nose to the lips, and rests on the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; the white background and overexposed skin areas create a seamless void that isolates the features.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid Magenta (Small graphic detail on the wrist)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with near-zero saturation, except for one isolated high-chroma point.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used at different scales to maintain minimalist consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp terminals match the clean aesthetic.
Perfectly circular forms and high x-height align with the display style.
Modern geometric feel with excellent legibility at wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed black and white portrait of a woman with wet-styled hair, centered, looking directly at the camera. The skin should be so bright it blends into the pure white background, leaving only the eyes, eyebrows, and lips in sharp, dark contrast. Include a tiny, bright pink heart-shaped mark on the inner wrist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in a geometric sans-serif font like Futura. The top line should be large uppercase letters with extreme tracking (approx 600). The bottom line should be smaller uppercase letters with similar wide tracking. All text must be solid black and centered.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the text wide enough to span nearly the full width of the frame?
Are the eyes the sharpest point of contrast in the image?
Is the pink accent mark small and isolated?

adjustableVariables: Color of the small accent mark
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not touch the subject's head or hands.
Check that the 'wet' texture of the hair is visible despite the high exposure.
Verify that the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Confirm the single color accent is the only non-grayscale element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, overexposed centered portrait with wide-tracked geometric sans-serif typography at the vertical extremes to create a minimalist, high-fashion editorial look.
